The lock keeps this phone browsing with Family Site Blocker: another browser is turned away, and the app cannot be removed or switched off. Turning the lock off takes a wait you choose, worked through by the phone itself, so nothing skips it.

resources.string: Out of the lock\'s reach: safe mode, a factory reset, another user, a Private space or a work profile set up before the lock was on, and web pages shown inside other apps. The record shows when the accessibility service went off.
This phone browses with Family Site Blocker
%1$s was turned away. Open the page in Family Site Blocker instead.
Removing or switching off Family Site Blocker, or changing what the phone lets it do, waits until the lock is off. The Lock page in the menu says how.
One tap on that screen switches the lock off. So it stays closed until the lock is off. The Lock page in the menu says how.
Developer options, Users, and setting up a Private space or a work profile each open a way round the lock. They stay closed until the lock is off. The Lock page in the menu says how.

A browser allowed to display over other apps can float a page over everything else on the screen. So that setting stays closed for other browsers until the lock is off. The Lock page in the menu says how.
%1$s was turned away. Until %2$s this phone is for calls and the clock.
%1$s was turned away. Until bedtime is over this phone is for calls and the clock.
The lock holds the phone’s clock
A bedtime is set, and it goes by this phone’s clock. Changing the date, the time or the time zone waits until the lock is off. The Lock page in the menu says how.
To turn the lock off: the menu, Lock, Start unlocking. It takes the wait chosen when it was turned on.
No bedtime is set. Set one in the menu’s Settings, under Bedtime.
Bedtime is %1$s to %2$s: every site is blocked then.
While the lock is on, every other app is turned away then too. Left open: %1$s.
While the lock is on, every other app is turned away then too, except calls and the clock.
The lock holds this: it changes only while the lock is off.
Turn other apps away at bedtime
Leave other apps open at bedtime

At bedtime, while the lock is on, every app is turned away except this one, calls, the clock and Settings. That takes in maps, messages and the camera. Once the lock is on, leaving other apps open again takes the lock’s wait.
Other apps close then, and every site is blocked. Finish what you are writing.
Keeps this phone browsing with Family Site Blocker.

Family Site Blocker uses this to see which app has come to the front, so that another browser can be turned away while the lock is on, and other apps at bedtime if that is switched on, and which Settings screen is open or tapped, so that the lock cannot be removed without its wait, nor the phone’s clock changed while a bedtime is set. While the lock is on it also closes Security & privacy, where one tap switches the lock off, and Developer options, Users, the setting up of a Private space or a work profile, and the switch that lets another browser display over other apps, which open ways round it. It reads nothing else: in Settings, on Android’s screens that remove an app or change its permissions, and in what is tapped in Settings’ search and on the home screen, it looks for its own name, for another browser’s name beside that switch, for the titles of those screens, and for the words of Date & time and the time zone.
Family Site Blocker asks for no powers over this phone, so Android lists no operations for it. While this is on, Android does not uninstall the app.
Without this, Android can uninstall Family Site Blocker, and its lock cannot hold.
